lines.text: Every AI agent. One workspace you own.
In a project, you give the coordinator a goal.
It starts a worker for each part and lists them in the Threads rail.
Each job gets the model that fits.
Here Codex writes tip.py while Claude writes the README.
lines.say: Here, Codex writes tip dot p y, while Claude writes the read me.

lines.text: Results come back to one conversation. The coordinator checks each worker's output against the goal.
Hit a limit? SpecWithCode shows every account's limits.
lines.say: Hit a limit? Spec With Code shows every account's limits.

lines.text: When Claude runs out, Continue with Codex carries the conversation over, so Codex knows the word only Claude was told.
One record in git. The open-source CLI hands off at 90%, and any agent picks it up.
lines.say: One record in git. The open-source C L I hands off at ninety percent, and any agent picks it up.

lines.text: Bring your agents. Keep your machines.
